name: Linker Hand L6
summary: Linker Hand L6 is LinkerBot's industrial dexterous hand built around electric-cylinder actuation and linkage transmission. Six active and five passive degrees of freedom provide coordinated finger movement for assembly and grasping irregular objects. The manufacturer describes integrated drive and control, using brushless motors and ball screws in its actuators. The official table lists a 607 g mass, CAN and RS485 communication, 24 V operation and repeatability below ±0.2 mm. Whole-hand grip, individual fingertip force and structural load are separate specifications and should not be compared
